inputs.label: Pro Bowl flag-football conference roster strength (actual participants)
inputs.measures: Conference win probability in the Pro Bowl flag game as a function of the quarterbacks and skill players who actually participate after opt-outs and replacements.
inputs.remaining_blocker: needs point-in-time vintages captured from now on (see docs/PROSPECTIVE_CAPTURE.md)

inputs.label: Starting QB status and QB-specific regime
inputs.measures: The starting QB is the single biggest swing factor in team strength; moves between starter and backup shift the spread by ~3-10 points and change pass volume, efficiency and scoring.
inputs.remaining_blocker: needs point-in-time vintages captured from now on (see docs/PROSPECTIVE_CAPTURE.md)

inputs.label: QB completion-count model: expected completion probability by attempt mix with accuracy over expected (market-free)
inputs.measures: Converts a forecast attempt distribution into a completions distribution using per-attempt expected completion probability (target depth, pressure, receiver separation) plus the QB's shrunk completion-over-expected.

inputs.label: QB expected passing TDs (xPassTD) from dropback-level location and target
inputs.measures: Sum over a QB's dropbacks of the probability that the attempt becomes a TD given field position, down, distance, target type and defensive look.

inputs.label: Joint four-quarter total distribution: argmax quarter (with dead-heat share) and P(minimum quarter = 0)
inputs.measures: Simulated joint distribution of the four regulation quarter totals from drive allocation and period-specific per-drive scoring, summarised as P(quarter q is the unique or shared maximum, weighted 1/N) and P(any quarter total = 0).

inputs.label: Route-weighted receiving-corps quality for the projected active set
inputs.measures: Aggregate of expected separation, catch-probability-over-expected and yards after catch over expected across the receivers and backs projected to run routes, weighted by projected route share.
inputs.remaining_blocker: needs point-in-time vintages captured from now on (see docs/PROSPECTIVE_CAPTURE.md)

inputs.label: Route participation and alignment
inputs.measures: Routes run (share of dropbacks) measure how often a receiver actually runs a pattern; targets per route run (TPRR) and yards per route run (YPRR) are the cleanest efficiency/usage decomposition.
inputs.remaining_blocker: data already held: needs a builder, replay and blind match

inputs.label: Drive-sequence score-path simulation: largest lead, lead changes and comeback events
inputs.measures: Simulates the alternating drive sequence of both teams with per-drive outcomes and point values, recording the full in-game margin path so path functionals (maximum lead, lead changes, minimum margin of the eventual winner) can be read.

inputs.label: WR/TE/RB availability and replacement quality
inputs.measures: Absence of a primary receiver or back redistributes targets and carries to replacements with different efficiency, altering both the team ceiling and individual prop expectations.

inputs.label: Touchdown luck and yards-to-points regression
inputs.measures: Touchdowns per yard or per target for a player or team above/below the expected rate given field position and usage are largely noise, producing regression in subsequent games and in season totals.

inputs.label: State-conditional total plays model (mutual tempo with lead effects)
inputs.measures: Total plays are a function of both teams' seconds per play, run rates, expected lead state and clock stoppages rather than the average of two neutral paces.

inputs.label: Kickoff-hour weather forecast vintages (wind, temp, precipitation)
inputs.measures: Wind, rain, snow and cold reduce passing efficiency, deep passing, kicking accuracy and scoring, and raise run share; forecasts update through game week.

inputs.label: Weather dose-response function for totals (wind, cold, precipitation, roof)

inputs.label: With/without target redistribution matrix for the projected inactive set
